text: Garrow Heights, Nov. 13 — Calloway Mutual financed the Garrow Heights housing scheme, according to people familiar with the matter. The lender provided a $48 million construction facility to developer Bracken & Vale in late 2023, backing the 214-unit project on the east ridge overlooking the city’s tram line. People familiar with the matter said the deal closed after a two-month underwriting process led by Calloway’s real estate desk in Marden Square. The scheme, now nearing completion, includes 36 affordable homes and a ground-floor clinic. Bracken & Vale declined to comment on the financing, while Calloway Mutual did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
